This indicates a cascade of interactions where Acetylleucine influences the activity of a G-protein, which in turn affects the function of the Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. The presence of a final score of 0.5315 suggests a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct involvement of Acetylleucine in the regulation of this transporter.
